nodes.label: Block finality

nodes.rationale: Doomslug block production readiness uses more than two-thirds stake thresholds; header validation checks approvals and last-final ancestry separately.

nodes.label: Stateless chunk replay
nodes.community_name: Stateless chunk replay / Sampled chunk endorsements / Block finality
nodes.rationale: Stateless validation authenticates source and destination shard IDs and receipt Merkle paths, re-executes recorded state, and checks state/header, outgoing receipt, transaction and encoded roots.

nodes.label: Sampled chunk endorsements
nodes.community_name: Stateless chunk replay / Sampled chunk endorsements / Block finality
nodes.rationale: NEP-509 defines witness-based replay and sampled chunk endorsements, assumes at most one-third corrupted stake, and explicitly excludes ZK integration from scope.

nodes.label: Account scoped storage
nodes.community_name: Stateless chunk replay / Sampled chunk endorsements / Block finality
nodes.rationale: Runtime storage keys bind ContractData to current account; writes are prospective TrieUpdate entries while reads record witness paths.

nodes.label: Signed transaction authentication
nodes.community_name: Signed transaction authentication / Transaction to receipt conversion / Owner authorized deployment
nodes.rationale: ValidatedTransaction verifies the signed transaction hash against its transaction public key; this establishes signature validity, not a proof of user outcome constraints.

nodes.label: Owner authorized deployment
nodes.community_name: Signed transaction authentication / Transaction to receipt conversion / Owner authorized deployment
nodes.rationale: Deployment requires account actor authorization and stores supplied code with storage accounting; the inspected path has no maintainer program admission list. This bounded inspection is not a whole-repository negative proof.

nodes.label: Receipt backpressure
nodes.community_name: Signed transaction authentication / Transaction to receipt conversion / Owner authorized deployment
nodes.rationale: Cross-shard receipt forwarding can buffer receipts persistently under gas/bandwidth congestion limits.

nodes.label: Transaction to receipt conversion
nodes.community_name: Signed transaction authentication / Transaction to receipt conversion / Owner authorized deployment
nodes.rationale: Accepted transactions create an ActionReceipt and SuccessReceiptId; signer-equal receivers enter a local queue, others go through forwarding or buffering.
